# SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.9 Scientific-Owner Freeze

Date: 2026-08-20

Owner statement:

> Freeze SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.9.

Status: Scientific authority frozen; implementation conformity not yet assessed
under this contract.

## Frozen authority

The owner statement freezes SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.9 as the scientific authority for
the scope represented by:

- the science-team rationale and its companion six-file shared normative core;
- the engineering conformance view, whose view-specific guidance is
  informative and introduces no independent normative science;
- owner Decisions 1--9 and the preceding approved scope and packet decisions;
- the 24 author-draft decisions, the scientific-owner decision ledger, and the
  exact authority crosswalk; and
- the two canonical v0.1/r0.9 PDF renderings recorded in `pdf/README.md`.

The 63 `OPEN`, one `CONDITIONAL`, and five `DEFERRED` ledger entries retain
their recorded states. Freezing the authority does not supply a missing
number, method, tolerance, policy, or evidence threshold and does not make a
blocked operation or claim available. The 14 `RESOLVED` entries retain their
recorded authority.

## Claim boundary

This freeze establishes scientific authority only. It does not assert or
provide evidence of implementation conformity, representation fidelity,
scientific validation, observational performance, science qualification, or
production readiness. Those are later, separately authorized review and
validation activities.

The next planned activity is the RTC--CAL--PTC play-well-together coherence
review. That cross-package review may identify a need for successor authority,
but it does not silently amend this frozen revision.

## Change control

The freeze is status-only: it changes no normative identifier, equation,
requirement, prediction, owner-ledger state, or scientific meaning in r0.9.
Any future substantive correction, resolved open choice, or changed scientific
boundary requires explicit owner authority and a versioned successor or
formally reopened revision. Frozen r0.9 authority must not be silently edited.
